items.title: NiSource (NI) Stock Rises As Q3 Earnings Beat Meets Funding Strain
items.summary: NiSource just cleared another quarterly hurdle with its Q3 2026 report, and the stock wasted no time reacting. Shares closed at US$44.75, up about 2% on the day, as traders leaned into what looked like a clean headline beat and firmer earnings outlook. The real story sits in profitability. Adjusted earnings per share of roughly US$0.27 and net income of US$129.1m keep the trailing net margin near 13.5%, a level that matters for a regulated utility funding a heavy capital plan.
